title: Frame-driven QA loop
purpose: Compare implemented Admin V0.2 states against approved frames with browser evidence.
scope_boundary: Visual fidelity, responsive behavior, console checks, and QA evidence only.
entry_condition: A screen state or modal state has been implemented in local WordPress.
exit_condition: Screenshot evidence, console result, and drift notes are recorded for the state group.

budgets.time_budget: one QA pass per state group
budgets.validation_budget: human validation if visual source conflict remains

tests.objective: Verify the implemented Filter Preset states against approved frames.
preconditions: Local WordPress admin page is reachable.
steps: Capture desktop screenshots for each implemented state.
Capture mobile/tablet screenshots for representative states.
Record drift notes and evidence paths.
tests.expected_result: Implemented states are recognizably the same product system as the frames and have no blocking layout or console issues.

handoff_notes: Lint/render checks alone do not close a visual task.
